supplyChainAdvisories.affectedArtifact: tomicdd/artex (legacy Docker Hub image) & deleted Autumn-27/ARTEX upstream
supplyChainAdvisories.summary: Static binary disassembly proved the legacy prebuilt Docker Hub image injected an unauthenticated command-execution backdoor inside server.verifyCaptcha and upstream removed engagement-scope enforcement (guard/guard.go).
supplyChainAdvisories.recommendation: Never pull third-party prebuilt ARTEX containers. Use the audited source-built, localhost-bound failsafe-security/artex distribution or inspect the patched BaaRai/ARTEX source build inside an isolated authorized lab.
